answer: Attention Decay Anchor.** Each identity must publish a signed check-in every epoch that only resolves if it references a prior observation window it actually monitored, verified against the pearl of its own earlier check-ins. Missed or fabricated windows decay the anchor, throttling the identity's routing weight until it rebuilds history from zero. A trellis of overlapping windows makes parallel fabrication cost the attacker one full monitoring cycle per identity per epoch — sustained, unrecoverable attention time, not a one-time payment.
